item.title: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated ‘slop’
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: LinkedIn is introducing new ways to reduce low-quality AI-generated posts, including a “seems like AI slop” reporting option. It's also replacing its own AI writing feature with a proofreading tool.

item.title: Synthetic-user startup Simile raises $200M at $2B valuation 5 months after $100M Series A
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Add another member to the fast-and-furious AI unicorn club: Simile

item.title: Spotify launches ‘User notes’ to let users add memories to songs
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Spotify says the new feature is designed to let users add personal captions to their favorite songs, such as noting why a track was added to a playlist or when they first discovered it

item.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: The deal gives Okta identity threat detection capabilities as enterprises seek to secure AI agents and other non-human identities across cloud environments.

item.title: Tesla made its 10 millionth EV
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The milestone means Tesla is halfway to accomplishing one of the four core product goals Elon Musk has to hit to unlock his full $1 trillion pay package.

item.title: When will fusion power startup Commonwealth Fusion Systems go public?
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: There are fresh signs that fusion power startup Commonwealth Fusion Systems will list in the next two to three years.

item.title: Meta says AI is making it easier to build new apps — and more are coming
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta says AI is making it dramatically easier to build and launch new consumer apps, with CEO Mark Zuckerberg telling investors the company has more new consumer products on the way following a recent wave of releases for Facebook Groups, Marketplace sellers, Instagram, and gaming.

item.title: Netflix lands global streaming deal for ‘The Walking Dead’
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Netflix just signed a massive new licensing agreement worth $500 million to bring The Walking Dead Universe to international markets.

item.title: Nscale buys Anyscale as it seeks to own more of the AI compute stack
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: British AI neocloud Nscale is buying software startup Anyscale, which helps companies scale their AI workloads across data centers and servers.

item.title: Fusion power darling Commonwealth Fusion Systems raises another $1B
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Commonwealth Fusion Systems raised $1 billion as the startup moves toward its first commercial fusion power plant.

item.title: Forward-deployed engineers are the AI industry’s latest talent obsession
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: A new study estimates only 2,000 U.S. engineers have the expertise to deliver meaningful AI ROI, as enterprises race to hire forward-deployed engineers to implement AI at scale.

item.title: In the Hugging Face breach, OpenAI’s hacker was noisy and fast — but not unstoppable
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: Cybersecurity experts told TechCrunch that one of the biggest lessons to be taken from the OpenAI hack against Hugging Face has nothing to do with AI, but traditional cybersecurity defense.

item.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s biggest stage features leaders from Amazon, Replit, Tether, with much more to come
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: The Disrupt Stage is where many of the biggest conversations in technology happen, with a legacy that stretches back for more than a decade.

item.title: FTC sues Hims & Hers for allegedly sharing patients’ medical data with advertisers Meta and Snap
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The U.S. federal consumer watchdog said Hims & Hers, which prescribes for sexual wellness and mental health conditions, used website trackers to share customers' information with advertisers.

item.title: Zoox clears final federal hurdle to launch paid robotaxi service
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Federal safety regulators have given Zoox a temporary exemption that will allow the Amazon-owned autonomous vehicle technology company to charge customers for rides in its custom-built robotaxi.

item.title: Spotify adds a running mode to its app
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Running Mode will be available to Premium users on iOS in select countries.

item.title: Inforcer raises $50M to help prepare smaller businesses for a new world of AI and security risks
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: London-based Inforcer just closed a $50 million Series C round led by Insight Partners.

item.title: Dili raises $21.7M to bring AI compliance to the infrastructure boom
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: The Series A was led by Khosla Ventures, with participation from Allianz, Rebel Fund, Brick and Mortar Ventures’ Darren Bechtel, and Y Combinator’s Garry Tan.

item.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models, harnesses, and even a Mythos competitor on Wednesday, telling Wall Street it plans for continued growth.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: As Meta pours billions into AI infrastructure and agents, Zuckerberg is working to convince investors that the payoff will be worth the price.
